# Battalion

> Italian Restaurant in San Antonio, Texas. Pasta, meatballs and a short menu in the historic Firehouse #7, at the entrance to Southtown.

- Phone: (210) 816-0088
- Address: 604 S Alamo St, San Antonio, TX 78205
- Areas: San Antonio, Converse, Schertz, Boerne, New Braunfels
- Offers: Starters; Pasta and fish; Bar and dessert
- Rating: 4.5 from 1912 Google reviews
